prerequisites: Knowledge acquired in access degrees as listed in the Master's Program Memory
Having completed the subjects developed in the first semester of the Master

learning_outcomes.text: Know the contents developed in this module.
Acquisition of laboratory work skills and systematics, specific to the subjects taught.
Manage the scientific equipment used in these subjects to design specific tests or experiments and to interpret the results obtained.
Write a scientific paper concisely and present it orally with clarity.

syllabus_topics: Advanced topics related to structural integrity, including specialized subjects, topics at the forefront of knowledge, or new topics of recent professional application.
Specific practical work complementing the practical part of the Numerical Simulation course (e.g., modeling crack growth, material models).
Practical complements for any other Master's subject, if deemed necessary.
Initial contact of Master's students with doctoral studies, presenting current research projects of the group.
teaching_methods: Verbal exposition by the professor of general contents
Provision of necessary materials for understanding

assessment_methods.method: Resolution of exercises or specific tasks related to the topic presented
Assessment of student participation in class development
Test at the end of the seminar

assessment_rules: Given the specificity of this Advanced Seminar, the mode of evaluation cannot be indicated a priori. Different possibilities are considered, such as a short written exam at the end of the professors' expository classes, resolution of exercises or specific tasks, and assessment of student participation. At a minimum, a test will be conducted at the end of the seminar. Exceptionally, if sanitary conditions require it, non-face-to-face evaluation activities may be included, and students will be informed of the changes.
bibliography: Text or notes prepared by the professor(s) teaching the content of the different topics of the subject.
A set of available exercises or problems with their solutions.
